disclaimer: Evidence for the listed Trust Services Criteria, generated from the gateway's audit trail for the period shown. This is supporting evidence for specific controls — not a SOC 2 certification, attestation, or opinion.

controls.title: Logical access — identification, authentication, authorization
controls.requirement: Logical access to the system and data is restricted through identification, authentication, and authorization.
controls.howSatisfied: Every request is identity-verified and evaluated by the policy decision point (PDP) before access; delegated access uses short-lived, sender-constrained on-behalf-of tokens.

evidence.label: Requests attributed to a verified human identity

controls.title: Registration & authorization prior to access
controls.requirement: Users are registered and authorized prior to being granted system access.
controls.howSatisfied: Agents are registered in the identity registry and must be approved before they can act; unapproved agents are denied at the boundary.

controls.title: Least privilege & role-based restriction
controls.requirement: Access is granted per role and least privilege, restricted to what is necessary.
controls.howSatisfied: Capability profiles and Cedar policies restrict each agent to an explicit allow-set; recorded denials show the restriction is actively enforced.

controls.title: Security monitoring & audit logging
controls.requirement: System components are monitored and security-relevant events are logged to detect anomalies.
controls.howSatisfied: Every request, decision, and token issuance is recorded to an append-only audit trail spanning identity, policy, and delegation.

controls.title: Evaluation & attribution of security events
controls.requirement: Detected security events are evaluated to determine whether they are incidents.
controls.howSatisfied: Each decision is recorded with its outcome and attributed to the deciding policy, so events can be reviewed and traced.

evidence.label: Decisions attributed to a deciding policy

controls.title: Change management — access policy governance
controls.requirement: Changes to the system, including access policies, are authorized, tracked, and documented.
controls.howSatisfied: Access policies carry authorship and source (manual, generated, or system default) and change timestamps.
